name: efficiency-companion
description: A small helper above the typing box: context bar, model, working agents, efficiency tips, and shorter command output with recoverable originals.

enabled.title: Turn on
enabled.description: Turn the whole helper on or off.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: apply shortens long command output. observe only measures it and changes nothing.

redactSecrets.title: Hide secrets
redactSecrets.description: Mask likely passwords and keys in command output.

minBytes.title: Shorten from (bytes)
minBytes.description: Only shorten output longer than this many bytes.

contextPercent.title: Long chat warning (%)
contextPercent.description: Suggest a fresh chat when the chat is this full.

maxTurns.title: Long chat warning (messages)
maxTurns.description: Suggest a fresh chat after this many of your messages.

duplicateThreshold.title: Repeated reads warning
duplicateThreshold.description: Warn after this many repeated reads of the same file.

maxCacheEntries.title: Read memory size
maxCacheEntries.description: How many recent file reads to remember for spotting repeats.

archiveBudgetBytes.title: Original storage (bytes)
archiveBudgetBytes.description: How much space to use for keeping full originals of shortened output.

diffContextReduction.title: Shorten git diffs
diffContextReduction.description: Also shorten unchanged lines in git diffs. Changed lines are always kept.

telemetry.title: Keep local stats
telemetry.description: Keep simple savings counts on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.

animateCompanion.title: Animate the helper
animateCompanion.description: Let the helper breathe, blink and react. Reduce Motion always turns it off.

tips.title: Efficiency tips
tips.description: Show short tips about model choice and effort level above the typing box.

skin.title: Helper colour
skin.description: Colour of the helper above the typing box.
